spec.name: tap-uninstall-restores
spec.intent: Census @15c799dd (the unit's second landing; design and notebook as at 66154b42); every path is repo-relative on the plan's line. A line number, count or observed behaviour cited here is a measurement at that commit: re-derive it if its path changed since. Add no new test file. Run one test file inside its package with `pnpm exec vitest run <file>`. Realize uninstall for the event tap on Claude Code: `cratylus eventTap uninstall` removes from the host everything `eventTap install` placed there and nothing the host placed or changed itself, which is left in place and reported. STARTING STATE: the unit's landings (f95d1f92, 15c799dd) stand and are built on: uninstall removes a settings file and a .claude directory that install created when nothing else is in them. WHAT IS MISSING (assay of f95d1f92, ledger entry 2; note 'eventTap uninstall reports nothing it leaves in place'). (1) Reported: uninstall's result is always {"verb":"uninstall"} (packages/runtime/src/capabilities/event-tap/dispatch.ts, case 'uninstall' ~L249-251, and the result type ~L56-65), because the port's remove returns nothing (packages/runtime/src/ports/event-tap.ts:57; EventTapHostClaude.remove, packages/runtime/src/capabilities/event-tap/claude.ts:214). A settings file install created but the host has since added a key to, and a .claude directory install created that the host has since put a file in, are kept and named nowhere. CHANGE: the port's remove returns what it left in place, and why; dispatch puts that in uninstall's result (main.ts prints it as JSON, as every eventTap result); with nothing left the result says nothing more than today. (2) As the host had it: a settings file that existed before install comes back as the host had it, byte for byte, when nothing else in it changed: an empty file stays empty rather than {} and a file in the host's own layout (4-space indent, one line) is not rewritten in 2-space JSON, whether or not it holds hooks of its own; where the host changed the file since install, only the tap's entries are taken out and the host's own content is kept. Re-derive at 15c799dd which of these the second landing already holds. Add .changeset/tap-uninstall-restores.md (patch for @cratylus/runtime and cratylus) if the landings lack one.
